line: I’m in LA smokin’ dope up on Melrose (Gang)
vault_lines: I'm in LA smokin' dope up on Melrose (Gang)
meaning: Melrose Avenue in LA is famous for luxurious shopping, dining, and entertainment.

line: Put that boy in the water, ayy, let’s go find Nemo
vault_lines: Put that boy in the water, ayy, let's go find Nemo
meaning: “Find Nemo” is a reference to the Disney-Pixar movie, “Finding Nemo”, a story about a clownfish (Nemo) who is lost after he is snatched by a fisherman in front of his father (Marvin) and Marvin and Dory, another fish that Marvin runs into, venture across the oceans to find Nemo.

line: I just sold an eight to a white boy in the ’Dova (a white) But really he just played ’cause it was some baking soda (finesse)
vault_lines: I just sold an eight to a white boy in the 'Dova (a white)
meaning: “The ‘Dova” is a nickname for the suburbs of Memphis where he sold narcotics to a kid or what the kid thought was narcotics. Supposedly, it was just baking soda and the kid was not aware.

line: Nigga playin’ with the crew like we ain’t gon’ shoot (woo woo) Ooh-woo, now them grapes come through (ooh-woo)
vault_lines: Nigga playin' with the crew like we ain't gon' shoot (woo woo)
meaning:
BlocBoy JB associates with the Grape Street Watts Crips. The gang is based in the Watts neighborhood of Los Angeles, California, but it also has members in Memphis which is BlocBoy JB’s hometown.

BlocBoy refers to the members of the gang as “Grapes”, members of the gang have proven that they will shoot. BlocBoy insinuates that the members of his gang will shoot you if you’re messing with them.

BlocBoy has also been seen with rapper 03 Greedo, a fellow Crip and actual Watts Street resident, although in mid-2018 he begun a 20 year prison sentence at the Fort Stockton Transfer Unit in Ft. Stockton, Texas. Both artists were also featured on Lil One Hunnet’s “We Bangin' Grape.”

line: Pump blew him in the kitchen from the doorstep
vault_lines: Pump blew him in the kitchen from the doorstep (damn)
meaning:
Savage borrows and adapts a line from Lil Wayne’s Da Drought 3-era track “Hard Body”:

Shoot a nigga on his porch and make him fall in his kitchen

line: Nigga disrespect me, he get shit-bagged up
vault_lines: Nigga disrespect me, he get shit-bagged up (21)
meaning: Savage threatens that those who disrespect him will be shot and suffer wounds that would require the wearing a colostomy bag (colloquially known as a “shit-bag”). Depending on the path the bullets take once they enter the body, victims of gun violence may suffer intestinal perforations (rips and tears in the intestines); until those intestinal perforations heal, the victim may have to wear a colostomy bag to reroute feces to a bag over his or her skin.

line: First 48 and yellow tape keep you from comin’ through
vault_lines: First 48 and yellow tape keep you from comin' through
meaning:
The First 48 is a reality show on A&E where detectives take you trough the first 48 hours of a homicide investigation. Filmed in the United States, the show has ran on for 16 seasons.



Barricade tape, usually yellow and black, is a tape used to block off crime scenes. This could also mean that the tape is keeping you off from the crime scene for the first 48 hours.

line: Whole lotta gang shit nigga, Grape Street nigga
vault_lines: Whole lotta gang shit nigga, Grape Street nigga
meaning:
Grape Street Watts Crips is a Los Angeles based gang that is primarily African American.
The Grape Street Crips have an affiliated branch named the Peda Roll Mafia which is from Memphis and used as a medium for drug trafficking.

BlocBoy is from Memphis and his affiliation with the Grape Street Crips is expressed through many of his verses and tracks just like “Pull Up” which was released in late 2017.

line: Ridin’ in the fuckin’ Bentayga (yeah) Salt kill snails, not playas (yeah)
meaning:
21 interpolates the opening line of the chorus, referencing the Bentley Bentayga, a luxury SUV. Given his success in the rap-game 21 can now afford such luxuries.

However that doesn’t stop others from being salty at his success. Unfortunately for those people, salt only kills snails due to it triggering osmosis and drawing the water out of the snail, killing it via dehydration.

The line might also be a nod to Migos' “Too Playa” in which Offset, 21’s Without Warning collaborator, raps:

New Moncler (drip), throwin' salt on a playa (salt)
Save the salt for the snails (salt)

In 2017, 21 Savage raced Offset in his Bentley Bentayga.
